attack_budget.planning_estimate: 3 adversarial sessions x up to 20 executed attempts at Level 0 (handoff §15); a workload estimate, not coverage

attacker.access: the role's allowlisted research checkout (boundaries.ALLOWLIST), the public MCP open tier and permitted development feedback
attacker.cooperating_identities: proposed: up to the three adversarial sessions may cooperate; sessions share no workspace or credential
attacker.feedback: submission state, typed refusal codes, resource outcome and public-practice aggregate components; no counted, private or confirmation case detail

structural: any canary or protected material in an exported artifact or event
any construction access to evaluator authority or grades

missing_results: a timeout or infrastructure failure is neither an attack pass nor a physics failure; it is recorded and counted against the budget

reconstruction.customer_rebuild: a second operator deterministically refits the registered closed-form KRR recipe from the same digest-pinned public TRAIN bytes on a clean worker
reconstruction.permitted_hardware: the pinned Linux CPU reconstruction worker; accelerators and wider hardware remain HUMAN_INPUT

separation: development uses published material only; confirmation material is held by an evaluator custodian outside every agent workspace and outside the implementing agent's development access

specimens.control: the same strategy with only length and ridge
specimens.specimen: kernel-ridge strategy with a field outside the Level-0 inventory

specimens.control: well-formed strict JSON using a registered grid point
specimens.expected: refused before compilation or worker dispatch
specimens.specimen: strategy with an unknown field, nonfinite ridge or duplicate JSON key

specimens.expected: only public aggregate practice feedback is disclosed
specimens.specimen: repeated practice requests probing private-pool or decision-reference fields

specimens.control: registered KRR rebuilt and evaluated on the complete public practice set
specimens.expected: typed gates and separate mean/ripple public-practice components expose the failure
specimens.specimen: flat torque curve with correct mean or a ripple curve shifted to the wrong phase

specimens.control: the default KRR recipe inside the declared CPU envelope
specimens.expected: FAILED_INFRA or resource refusal, never a physics or score failure
specimens.specimen: practice attempt exceeding the pinned worker deadline

specimens.control: worker staging contains only recipe code and digest-pinned public material
specimens.expected: the construction worker never receives it; any exposure halts dispatch
specimens.specimen: canary beside private or decision-study GetDP evidence outside the public allowlist

specimens.control: the declared recipe rebuilt from the registered package
specimens.expected: digest check or clean-worker rebuild fails closed
specimens.specimen: delivery package with changed TRAIN bytes or an undeclared dependency

specimens.control: fresh evaluator-held cases outside every construction workspace
specimens.specimen: fresh motor confirmation set held only by the evaluator custodian

stopping: stop expansion on any finding, escape, exposure, accepted mandatory failure or reconstruction mismatch; preserve evidence; retest with fresh confirmation material
unsupported_surfaces: executable submissions do not exist at Level 0; rejecting code sent through the declarative interface is not a containment test
